review: Independent bounded static native adapter ledger/preflight review
checks: Complete original command/text/scalar/scope/opacity validation covers all phases before image-table or mask materialization; original command attribution retained.

Image map count/capacity/key-byte/key-work limits precede sorting; identity uses shared Arc object identity with deterministic sorted key discovery and all-source validation. Missing images are legal omissions.

Nontext CPU bound is framebuffer area times all nontext inputs across phases; font Session gets only the remaining allowance. Rounded full-loop work is bounded by that debit, and shared font/rounded source,coverage,row and lowered-command ledgers run before backing allocation.
Fresh-font key order remains consistent with Session insertion order across phases and rounded interleaving; per-occurrence rows share the aggregate row ledger.

Checked GPU-byte upper bound includes source bytes, combined coverage/rows,image LUT allowance,lowered metadata,one packed target and one Native padded conversion reserve. Final core Plan bytes are checked against that bound.

Final global padded invocation admission remains in the core planner after bounded CPU preparation; this review does not claim every eventual work refusal occurs before all mask allocation. No partial core Plan is returned on any failure.
Phase scope state is independent; absolute glyph/rounded placement bypasses retranslation while original unrounded/image/line commands retain normal phase translation.

Preparation peak separately includes final packed arena,core structural overlap,raw coverage/rows,font raster scratch,descriptor/vector metadata,64 UI commands,16KiB UI strings and optional full reference. Browser currently uses text only in its chrome command vector; overlays are rectangles.
Returned NativeScenePlan owns only Plan and fixed stats. Actual capacity accessor and presenter packet admission supplement the pre-preparation structural reservation.
limits_and_attribution: No planner/font/Canvas/worker/GPU execution performed by reviewer.
19 private groups inspected as source; their execution results remain root-owned.

Peak is an explicit per-preparation allocation bound excluding allocator/driver overhead,borrowed assets,CPU font cache and trusted outline-library allocations, not a process RSS or arbitrary-font security guarantee.
Existing strict probe admission APIs remain separate; supported Native scenes do not rewrite original probe refusal oracles.
